comment: sidecar-pda-vectors.json in this directory is a byte-for-byte copy of the contracts repository's cross-language
sidecar PDA vector. Do not edit the copy. To take a newer contracts vector, copy the file from a newer contracts
commit on main, update every field below from that commit, and replace git-objects/ with that commit's objects:
root_store_sidecar_vectors_test.go checks on every run, without a contracts clone, that the copy's sha256 and git
blob id are the ones recorded here and that the recorded commit holds that blob at sourcePath: each object in
git-objects/ must hash to its file name, and the walk from the commit through its trees must end at the blob.
What only a contracts clone can show is that sourceCommit is on the contracts main line. scripts/run-tests.sh
passes a configured clone as MELUSINA_CONTRACTS_GIT_DIR, and a release or CI run fails without one.
